reply_text:
*I’d block the merge on two issues.*

1. *CRITICAL — Validator accepts invalid strings* — `src/validate.js:1–4`
   The unanchored regex matches any valid substring. Confirmed that `"HELLO-world"`, `"hello world"`, `"a/b"`, and `"hello\n"` all pass and produce URLs through `pagePath`. URL encoding doesn’t enforce the slug contract.
   *Fix:* Require a nonempty string with no characters outside `[a-z0-9-]`. Add rejection tests, including trailing newlines; JavaScript’s `$` anchor alone can match before a final newline.

2. *CRITICAL — Reserved slugs aren’t enforced* — `src/route.js:4`
   Neither `pagePath` nor its validator calls `isReserved`. Confirmed that all four reserved names—`new`, `edit`, `admin`, `api`—produce page URLs despite the documented prohibition.
   *Fix:* Check the reserved set in the page-path guard and add tests asserting that all four names throw.

All 4 existing tests pass, but none exercises `pagePath`; the reserved-word test checks only the helper, not enforcement.

Reviewed the full diff against `main` and all source/test files. No code changed.
